name: Nichiyoubi no Yaoya
source:
Yes, this is the place where a selfish god throws a tantrum and makes things difficult for me...
Onoshiro Town-
There is a town somewhere in Tokyo where spirits live, but there are no shrines or temples.
A poor girl who is a repeat student but still wears a high school uniform arrives there, along with a young local man who has nothing but girls on his mind, and a carefree god who protects the rundown apartment building.
The destinies of these three people, who were never meant to intersect, become deeply intertwined as they become involved in the spirits and guardians that lurk in the town.
A psychic battle action adventure brought to you by Jusanime.
There is something I want to protect.

[Machine Translated from [url=http://shiisanmei.web.fc2.com/product/nichihachi_story.htm]offcial website[/url]]
translation:
是的，这里就是自私的神发脾气刁难我的地方……
小野城町-
东京某处有一座城镇，那里居住着神灵，但没有神社或寺庙。
一个留校生却还穿着高中校服的贫穷女孩，一个一心只想着女孩的当地年轻人，以及一个无忧无虑的守护着破旧公寓楼的神。
这三个本不该有交集的人的命运，随着潜伏在小镇中的鬼魂和守护者的卷入而深深地交织在一起。
Jusanime为你带来一场心灵战斗动作冒险。
我有想要保护的东西。

[译自[url=http://shiisanmei.web.fc2.com/product/nichihachi_story.htm]官方网站[/url]]
